column1: # mapping_set_title: "G7 SBOM for AI minimum elements <-> SEMIC vocabularies"

# mapping_set_description: "Maps the 50 minimum-element concepts from 'SBOM for Artificial Intelligence - Minimum Elements' (G7 Cybersecurity Working Group, 2026-05-12) to terms from DCAT-AP (dcat:, dcterms:), MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 (mldcatap: = http://data.europa.eu/it6/), W3C Machine Learning Schema (mls:), W3C Data Privacy Vocabulary (dpv:), ADMS (adms:) and Schema.org (schema:). The mldcatap: prefix is an alias for the opaque namespace http://data.europa.eu/it6/ used in MLDCAT-AP; see https://semiceu.github.io/MLDCAT-AP/releases/3.1.0/. Concepts without a meaningful external-vocab mapping (Document author signature, data flow, hash algorithm/value, vulnerability referencing, cybersecurity policy, security controls) are omitted. The bom: bridge concept in see_also is the shared abstraction linking G7 AI to this vocabulary layer and to SPDX 3.1."

column8: comment
Author of the document document; dcterms:creator is "an entity primarily responsible for making the resource"
schema:author on a schema:DigitalDocument is a direct match for the document document author
dcat:version applies to datasets/distributions; relatedMatch because compliance documents are not canonical DCAT resources but the semantics are analogous
dcterms:conformsTo ("an established standard to which the resource conforms") covers the document format specification; format name is encoded in the choice of conformance target
Same as format name — the version of the format specification is part of the conformance target IRI; no separate dcterms/dcat field for format version
Tool that generated the document is a creator agent; dcterms:creator applies when the tool is modelled as the creating agent; relatedMatch because tool ≠ human creator
schema:name on the tool object (a schema:SoftwareApplication) carries the tool name
schema:softwareVersion on the tool's schema:SoftwareApplication object carries the tool version
dcterms:created is "date of creation of the resource"; Document timestamp is when the document was generated — close match
schema:dateCreated is the date of creation of the item — exact semantic match for SBOM creation timestamp
dcterms:hasPart approximates containment relationships; typed dependencies (DEPENDS_ON, CONTAINS, etc.) require a richer vocabulary; relatedMatch
schema:name on the schema:SoftwareApplication describing the AI system
dcterms:title is formally "a name given to the resource"; relatedMatch — title implies a formal heading while system-name is a product identifier
dcterms:hasPart ("a related resource included physically or logically in the described resource") approximates the component-of relationship
dcterms:publisher covers the distribution role; relatedMatch because producer also covers the manufacturing/development role
schema:manufacturer covers the manufacturing/development role of the AI system producer
schema:softwareVersion on a schema:SoftwareApplication carries the AI system release version
dcat:version is the generic version indicator; relatedMatch because it applies to catalogued datasets/resources rather than software specifically
schema:datePublished is the release/publication date of the AI system — close match for a formal release timestamp
dcterms:issued is "date of formal issuance/publication"; relatedMatch for release timestamp; dcterms:created would match a build time
DPV dpv:hasPersonalData captures whether the system processes personal data — covers the sensitivity dimension of data usage
dcterms:accessRights covers data access/sensitivity constraints; relatedMatch for the restrictions dimension of data usage
mls:hasInput is a property of mls:Run describing consumed data; approximates model input modalities; relatedMatch because it applies to training runs not deployed inference
mls:hasOutput on a mls:Run; approximates model output type; same relatedMatch caveat as hasInput
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 MachineLearningModel.intendedUse partially covers I/O scope by describing the intended context of use
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 MachineLearningModel.intendedUse is the closest single term for intended application area
dcterms:subject captures the topic/domain of the resource; relatedMatch for application domain
mls:Task in W3C MLS is the ML task type (classification, detection, etc.) — a narrower aspect of application area
schema:applicationCategory on a schema:SoftwareApplication gives the broad application category
schema:name on a schema:SoftwareApplication or mldcatap:MachineLearningModel carries the model name
dcterms:title as formal name of the resource; relatedMatch — same caveat as system-name
dcterms:identifier is "an unambiguous reference to the resource"; covers PURL, DOI, HuggingFace repo URL and other stable IDs
schema:identifier as a structured identifier on schema:SoftwareApplication or schema:Dataset
schema:softwareVersion carries the model weight/checkpoint version
dcat:version as generic version indicator; relatedMatch
dcterms:created for training/build time; relatedMatch because model timestamp can be training date or release date
schema:dateCreated for when the model was trained/built; relatedMatch — same ambiguity as dcterms:created
dcterms:publisher covers the entity making the model available
schema:manufacturer covers the entity that produced/trained the model
dcterms:description is a free-text account of the resource
schema:description on a schema:SoftwareApplication or mldcatap:MachineLearningModel
mls:Model in W3C MLS represents a trained model; the class itself subsumes model properties
mls:Algorithm covers the model architecture/algorithm dimension of model properties
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 MachineLearningModel class subsumes AI-specific properties including bias, limitations, architecture and risk profile
mls:hasInput on mls:Run; approximates model input modalities at training time
mls:hasOutput on mls:Run; approximates model output type at training time
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 MachineLearningModel.intendedUse partially describes I/O scope via intended use context
mls:Run represents a training execution with associated hyperparameters and data inputs
mls:HyperParameter covers the configuration settings used during training
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 MachineLearningModel.designSpecifications covers training methodology and design choices
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 MachineLearningModel.trainingProcess covers the training procedure
dcterms:license is "a legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource"
schema:license on a schema:SoftwareApplication or schema:Dataset carries the license URL or text
dcat:landingPage links to a primary web page for the resource (model card, Hugging Face page)
schema:url is a generic URL for the item — covers homepage and download links
schema:codeRepository on a schema:SoftwareSourceCode or schema:SoftwareApplication points to the source/weights repository
schema:name on a schema:Dataset or dcat:Dataset carries the dataset name
dcterms:title as formal name of the catalogued dataset
dcterms:description is a free-text account of the dataset
schema:description on a schema:Dataset
dcterms:type is "the nature or genre of the resource"; relatedMatch for dataset modality/content type
dcterms:identifier covers DOI, URL and other persistent identifiers for datasets
schema:identifier on a schema:Dataset

dcterms:provenance is "a statement of any changes in ownership and custody"; relatedMatch — dataset provenance in compliance document context covers collection and curation methodology, broader than custody chain
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 Dataset.dataProvenance directly covers data origin and provenance information
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 Dataset.collectionMethod covers how the data was collected — a key dimension of provenance
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 Dataset.curationMethod covers data cleaning and pre-processing — the pre-processing dimension of provenance
mls:DatasetCharacteristic in W3C MLS covers measurable properties of a dataset
MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0 Dataset.biasMethod covers the bias assessment methodology for the dataset — a key statistical property
dpv:hasPersonalData captures whether the dataset contains personal data — the primary sensitivity dimension
dcterms:accessRights covers access/confidentiality constraints on the dataset
dcterms:relation is the generic "a related resource" predicate; typed relationships (TRAINED_ON, TESTED_ON) require a richer vocabulary; relatedMatch
dcterms:license for the dataset distribution license
schema:license on a schema:Dataset
mls:Software in W3C MLS represents ML framework software implementations
schema:operatingSystem on a schema:SoftwareApplication covers the OS layer of the infrastructure stack
schema:runtimePlatform covers runtime environments (container runtimes, ML framework versions)
schema:processorRequirements on a schema:SoftwareApplication describes CPU/GPU requirements
schema:memoryRequirements covers RAM and VRAM requirements for AI accelerators
schema:storageRequirements covers disk/storage requirements for model weights and data
schema:Certification is a CreativeWork type representing a certification; relatedMatch for conformance to standards/regulations
dcterms:conformsTo ("an established standard to which the described resource conforms") covers standards compliance declarations
mls:DatasetCharacteristic approximates measurable model evaluation metrics; no direct vocabulary term for security-specific metrics
mls:DatasetCharacteristic is the nearest vocabulary term for quantitative model/system performance characteristics
DPV AI ai:AISystem is the class of AI systems (DPV 2.3); system name is an attribute of this class; relatedMatch because the concept is the name, not the system class itself
DPV AI ai:Capability represents what an AI system can do in a given domain — directly related to intended application area; relatedMatch because application area is broader than a single capability
DPV AI ai:Capability subsumes I/O interface characteristics — the capabilities of a system are defined by its inputs and outputs; relatedMatch
DPV AI ai:MachineLearningModel is the class of ML models; model name is an attribute of this class; relatedMatch because the concept is the name, not the class
DPV AI ai:MachineLearningModel subsumes the properties of a trained ML model including architecture, objectives and limitations — close match for the model properties collection
DPV AI ai:Capability represents what the model can do — related to but broader than a formal I/O specification
DPV AI ai:ModelTraining is the class representing the model training process including configuration and methodology — close match for training properties
DPV AI ai:DataCollection covers how training/testing data was gathered — a primary dimension of dataset provenance in AI SBOMs
DPV AI ai:DataPreparation covers data cleaning and pre-processing steps — the curation dimension of dataset provenance
DPV AI ai:BiasAssessment covers assessment of biases in the dataset — a key statistical property for AI training/testing datasets
